claim: Václav Noid Bárta wins the male singer category (Zpěvák) of the Český slavík 2026 music poll, announced at the gala in Prague's Forum Karlín on Friday 27 November 2026.

runs.scenario: If a presenter mistakenly names another singer and then corrects the announcement on air to name Bárta, one reader could resolve YES based on the corrected result, while another could apply the literal NO condition because another singer was also announced as the winner.
runs.yes_requires: Václav Noid Bárta must be announced as the first-place (zlatý slavík) winner of the Zpěvák category at the Český slavík 2026 gala broadcast live by TV Nova, within the 19:00–23:59 Europe/Prague window on 27 November 2026. A report published after the cutoff can verify an announcement made within the window.
runs.decided_by: The winner announcement at the gala, as shown on the TV Nova broadcast or reported by ČTK, TV Nova (tn.nova.cz), or another Czech national outlet.

runs.yes_requires: Václav Noid Bárta must be announced as the first-place winner ("zlatý slavík") of the Zpěvák category at the Český slavík 2026 gala broadcast live by TV Nova on 27 November 2026 between 19:00 and 23:59 Europe/Prague time.
runs.decided_by: The live TV Nova broadcast or reports from ČTK, TV Nova (tn.nova.cz), or another Czech national outlet regarding the announcement at the 27 November 2026 gala.

runs.scenario: The gala is held on 27 Nov 2026 and Václav Noid Bárta is announced on stage as Zpěvák winner, which ČTK reports, but TV Nova does not broadcast the gala live. One reader treats the live TV Nova broadcast as a mandatory YES condition and resolves NO because that event did not occur in the window; the other treats the broadcast phrase as descriptive, resolves YES on the ČTK report, and notes that neither explicit NO condition—a different winner, or no announcement on 27 Nov—is met.
runs.yes_requires: On 27 November 2026 (Europe/Prague), within 19:00–23:59, at the Český slavík 2026 gala, Václav Noid Bárta is announced as first place (zlatý slavík) in the Zpěvák category, as shown by TV Nova’s live broadcast or reported by ČTK, TV Nova (tn.nova.cz), or another Czech national outlet; a report published after 23:59 still counts if the announcement itself was made at that gala.
runs.decided_by: The TV Nova live broadcast of the gala, or reporting by ČTK, TV Nova (tn.nova.cz), or another Czech national outlet.
